Package/distribution boundaries are checked so external benchmark assets and retired browser-e2e assets do not leak into generated installs or npm package files.
Targeted tests, full test suite, task-state validation, build-version check, and strict Harness validator pass, or failures are recorded with next action.

Do not revert unrelated existing dirty worktree changes.

Keep wf-browser built in and browser-e2e retired as a warning no-op.
risks: Existing worktree contains many dirty files from earlier work; findings must separate scope.
